title: Deploy infrastructure through a constrained Azure pipeline
prompt: A team wants Azure Pipelines to deploy Bicep infrastructure to staging and production. Today, every pipeline can use a service connection with a stored client secret and broad subscription permissions. What should change before automating production deployments?

checks.value: (?i)(workload identity federation|federated credential|managed identity).{0,100}(service connection|pipeline|Azure)|(service connection|pipeline|Azure).{0,100}(workload identity federation|federated credential|managed identity)
store the client secret in the YAML

rubric: The response requires review and validation of infrastructure changes before deployment.
It recommends replacing stored long-lived credentials with Microsoft Entra workload identity federation or a supported managed identity option.
It scopes the service connection to the smallest required Azure scope and pipeline set.
It protects production with a separate environment and appropriate approval or resource checks.
No live Azure resource, credential or connection is modified.
acceptance: The response outlines a reviewable, staged IaC deployment with short-lived identity, least privilege and production gates.
